title: A client sends you a message

steps.caption: Messages
steps.narration: A client can write to you from their portal. Here is what happens when they do.

steps.caption: The client's portal
steps.narration: First, your client's screen. Rosa and Stefan Ferrante are signed in to their portal.

steps.caption: Messages
steps.narration: They choose Messages, and see the conversation so far.

steps.caption: To the office or one person
steps.narration: A message goes to the whole office, or to one person on their job.

steps.value: Could we move the site visit to the afternoon?
steps.caption: Write the message
Sent
steps.narration: The portal says the message was sent, and that you were notified.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Now your screen, in the CRM.

steps.caption: Unread count
steps.narration: The red number beside Messages went up by one.

steps.caption: The new message, waiting
steps.narration: Here is the new message. A timer shows how long the client has waited.

steps.caption: Open the conversation
steps.narration: Open it to read the whole conversation.

steps.value: Yes, 2 pm works. See you then.
steps.caption: Write your reply
Send the reply
steps.narration: Then send. Your reply shows in their portal, and goes to their email too.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Every client message lands under Messages, in the left menu.

youtube.title: What happens when a client messages you | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: See both sides of a client message in the ConstructHUB CRM. The client writes from their portal; the message lands in your Messages inbox with an unread count and a waiting timer, and your reply goes back to their portal and their email. Recorded in a demo workspace with a made-up client.
